instruction: I have a few things in my amazon cart. For each product type in it, buy the cheapest product and move the rest to the wish list.
notes: The cart contents are unknown before amazon.show_cart, so the problem uses placeholder products: two product types, each with one cheapest product and one or two more expensive ones (3 moves, matching the 10-call reference; the real number of types/products is read from show_cart at runtime and the problem objects/init facts should be instantiated accordingly). Static facts product-type-of / cheapest-in-type encode the price comparison; the move action is only applicable to non-cheapest products of a type, and it is blocked once the order is placed, so the planner must move all non-cheapest products to the wish list before amazon.place_order, and the cheapest of each type stays in the cart and is bought (order-placed + in-cart cheapest-x in the goal means 'purchased'). amazon.show_addresses / amazon.show_payment_cards supply the address_id and payment_card_id required by place_order; the extra non-API parameter on those actions names the record discovered. Quantities are assumed to be 1 in the cart (the evaluation requires ordered and wish-listed quantities of 1); the wish list is assumed empty initially. supervisor-complete-task takes no answer; its precondition is (order-placed) because the per-product wish-list goal facts cannot be enumerated generically in the domain without quantifiers, but every other action requires (not (task-completed)), so it is still necessarily the last action.
